name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer

third_party_evaluations.summary: Implements SRE, CI/CD, and observability on Google Cloud.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: SRE, delivery pipelines and observability at three years support professional cloud operations; the recorded proctored assessment does not independently establish expert hands-on security architecture.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded SRE, CI/CD and observability implementation with three years of experience fits professional cloud operations delivery. Vendor concentration and the absence of a stated practical limit evidence of independent incident command.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded SRE, CI/CD and observability scope supports delivery decisions at a three-year practitioner level. I credit modern operational relevance while withholding expert credit because practical assessment is unspecified.
